classification.difficultyReason: Distribute students into four transport groups, selecting the restricted walking group first in part b.

content.prompt: Twenty students, ten male and ten female, are to travel from school to the sports ground. Eight of them go in a minibus, six of them in cars, four of them on bikes and two walk.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In how many ways can they be distributed for the trip?

answer.worked:
Choose the minibus group, then the car group, then the bike group. The remaining two students walk.
$$\begin{aligned}N&={}^{20}C_8\times{}^{12}C_6\times{}^6C_4\times{}^2C_2\\&=1\,745\,944\,200.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: In how many ways can they be distributed if none of the boys walk?

answer.worked:
Choose the two walkers from the ten girls first. From the remaining 18 students, choose eight for the minibus, then six for cars. The remaining four ride bikes.
$$\begin{aligned}N&={}^{10}C_2\times{}^{18}C_8\times{}^{10}C_6\times{}^4C_4\\&=413\,513\,100.\end{aligned}$$
